title: example — exert

sentences.sentence: Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
sentences.translation: 许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

sentences.sentence: Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
sentences.translation: 工作时间每周不得超过42小时。

sentences.sentence: His performance exceeded our expectations.
sentences.translation: 他的表现出乎我们的预料。

sentences.sentence: Thank you. You’ve been exceedingly kind.
sentences.translation: 谢谢，你真是太好了。

sentences.sentence: The recording quality is excellent.
sentences.translation: 录制质量极好。

sentences.sentence: They were all there except me.
sentences.translation: 除了我以外他们都在那里。

sentences.sentence: We all went except him.
sentences.translation: 除他以外， 我们都去了。

sentences.sentence: They all howled with laughter except me.
sentences.translation: 除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

phrases.translation: 异常处理，异常情况处理；例外处理

sentences.sentence: It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
sentences.translation: 天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。

sentences.sentence: The law applies to all EU countries; Britain is no exception.
sentences.translation: 这项法律适用于所有欧盟国家，英国也不例外。

sentences.sentence: We don’t usually accept checks, but for you we’ll make an exception (= not include you in this rule ).
sentences.translation: 我们一般不接受支票，但对你我们就破个例。

sentences.sentence: The spelling of this word is an interesting exception to the rule.
sentences.translation: 这个单词的拼法是该规则一个有趣的例外。

sentences.sentence: Successful two-career couples are still the exception, not the rule (= used to emphasize that something is unusual ).
sentences.translation: 夫妇俩都事业有成的仍不常见。

phrases.translation: 超额生产能力；过剩设备
过负荷，超荷载；逾量荷载
过剩空气系数，过量空气系数

sentences.sentence: After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
sentences.translation: 涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

phrases.translation: 过度噪音；过分的吵闹声
过剩需求；过量需求；需求过旺

sentences.sentence: his excessive drinking
sentences.translation: 他的酗酒

sentences.sentence: $15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
sentences.translation: 两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

phrases.translation: 外汇；国际汇兑；外国汇票
中央银行所持有的自由兑换外汇准备
离子交换树脂（多孔合成树脂的总称）
外汇市场，外汇交易市场

sentences.sentence: It’s a place where people can chat and exchange ideas.
sentences.translation: 在这个地方人们可以聊天和交流想法。

sentences.sentence: His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
sentences.translation: 他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

sentences.sentence: an exciting discovery
sentences.translation: 激动人心的发现

sentences.sentence: ‘Julia and Paul are getting married!’ ‘Oh, how exciting!’
sentences.translation: “朱莉娅和保罗要结婚了！”“啊，太让人兴奋了！”

sentences.sentence: I’ve got some very exciting news for you.
sentences.translation: 我给你带来了一些很激动人心的消息。

sentences.sentence: Let’s do something exciting.
sentences.translation: 我们来做些让人振奋的事情吧。

sentences.sentence: Melanie finds her work exciting and rewarding.
sentences.translation: 梅拉妮觉得自己的工作既刺激又有意义。

sentences.sentence: ‘No!’ she exclaimed in shock.
sentences.translation: “不！”她惊呼道。

sentences.sentence: a special diet that excludes dairy products
sentences.translation: 不包含奶制品的特别食谱

sentences.sentence: The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly attained.
sentences.translation: 法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

sentences.sentence: These are not involved as exclusively as ministers in "soul-work," but they certainly cultivate the inner life more than the third group.
sentences.translation: 他们虽不像牧师那样专门做“灵魂方面的工作”，但是肯定比第三群体更注重于建造人类的生命。

sentences.sentence: a shopping excursion
sentences.translation: 购物游

phrases.translation: v. 为自己辩解；请求免除；请求准予离开
(对不能出席社交聚会等)表示抱歉(或遗憾)

sentences.sentence: I’ll excuse you this time, but don’t be late again.
sentences.translation: 这次我原谅你，但别再迟到了。

sentences.sentence: Please excuse my bad handwriting.
sentences.translation: 请原谅，我的字写得不好。

sentences.sentence: 13 people were summarily executed (= killed without any trial or legal process ) by the guerrillas.
sentences.translation: 有13人被游击队员就地处决。

phrases.translation: 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
猎头（等于headhunting）；搜寻高级管理人员（的做法）
行政权；执行权；行政管理权
行政管理；高级管理层；主管经理管理层
办公室；行政办公室；经理办公室

sentences.sentence: a commission with executive powers
sentences.translation: 有执行权的委员会

phrases.translation: 常规性的锻炼；经常操练，按时训练
行使价格；合约价；预购股票价格
运动生理学；运动生物学

sentences.sentence: Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
sentences.translation: 尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。

sentences.sentence: Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
sentences.translation: 由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

sentences.sentence: They exerted considerable influence within the school.
sentences.translation: 他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。

sentences.sentence: Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
sentences.translation: 环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。

text:
英语词汇 · 四级 · 第 126 单元

example
音标：英 /ɪg'zɑːmp(ə)l; eg-/  美 /ɪg'zæmpl/
n. 例子，实例；模范
短语：for example — 例如
短语：as an example — 例如；作为一个例子
短语：example of — 例证；…的例子；…的榜样
短语：set an example — 树立榜样
短语：numerical example — 数值例；数例
短语：give an example — 举例
短语：set an example for — 为某人树立榜样
短语：example code — 代码示例
短语：take example by — 以…为榜样；以…借鉴
短语：take for example — 以…为例
短语：counter example — 反例
短语：cite an example — 举例；引用一个例子
短语：without example — 没有先例
短语：beyond example — 没有先例，空前
短语：make an example of — 惩罚...以警戒他人
短语：example of case — 案例
例句：Many countries, for example Mexico and Japan, have a lot of earthquakes.
许多国家，例如墨西哥和日本，经常发生地震。

exceed
音标：英 /ɪk'siːd; ek-/  美 /ɪk'sid/
v. 超过，胜过；超出
短语：exceed in — 在…方面超过
例句：Working hours must not exceed 42 hours a week.
工作时间每周不得超过42小时。
例句：His performance exceeded our expectations.
他的表现出乎我们的预料。

exceedingly
音标：英 /ɪk'siːdɪŋlɪ; ek-/  美 /ɪk'sidɪŋli/
adv. 极端地，非常
例句：Thank you. You’ve been exceedingly kind.
谢谢，你真是太好了。

excellent
音标：英 /'eks(ə)l(ə)nt/  美 /'ɛksələnt/
adj. 优秀的，杰出的
短语：excellent quality — 优良品质；优良质量
短语：excellent student — 优秀学生；优等生
短语：excellent leader — 优秀干部；优秀领导
短语：excellent style — 漂亮的款式
短语：excellent league member — 优秀团员
短语：excellent feature — 优点
短语：excellent party member — 优秀党员
例句：The recording quality is excellent.
录制质量极好。

except
音标：英 /ɪk'sept; ek-/  美 /ɪk'sɛpt/
prep. 除…之外
短语：except for — 除了…以外；要不是由于
短语：except as — 除…之外
例句：They were all there except me.
除了我以外他们都在那里。
例句：We all went except him.
除他以外， 我们都去了。
例句：They all howled with laughter except me.
除了我以外，他们全都哈哈大笑起来。

exception
音标：英 /ɪk'sepʃ(ə)n; ek-/  美 /ɪk'sɛpʃən/
n. 例外，除外
短语：with the exception of — 除了…以外
短语：without exception — 无例外地，一律
短语：with the exception — 除了…情况
短语：no exception — 没有例外；无一例外
短语：an exception to — …的一个例外
短语：exception handling — 异常处理，异常情况处理；例外处理
短语：exception to the rule — 出轨边缘
短语：make an exception — 例外，破例
短语：take exception — 反对；有反感
短语：exception handler — 异常处理程序
例句：It’s been cold, but today’s an exception.
天气一直寒冷，但今天是个例外。
例句：The law applies to all EU countries; Britain is no exception.
这项法律适用于所有欧盟国家，英国也不例外。
例句：We don’t usually accept checks, but for you we’ll make an exception (= not include you in this rule ).
我们一般不接受支票，但对你我们就破个例。
例句：The spelling of this word is an interesting exception to the rule.
这个单词的拼法是该规则一个有趣的例外。
例句：Successful two-career couples are still the exception, not the rule (= used to emphasize that something is unusual ).
夫妇俩都事业有成的仍不常见。

excess
音标：英 /ɪk'ses; ek-; 'ekses/  美 /'ɛk'sɛs/
n. 超越；过量；过度
短语：in excess — 过度；过量地
短语：in excess of — 超过；较…为多
短语：excess capacity — 超额生产能力；过剩设备
短语：excess liquidity — 过剩流动性
短语：excess water — 过剩水量；过度水分
短语：excess air — （超过理论所需的）过量空气
短语：excess sludge — 剩余污泥
短语：excess heat — [物]余热；[机械]过剩热
短语：excess baggage — n. 超重行李；累赘
短语：excess load — 过负荷，超荷载；逾量荷载
短语：excess demand — 超额需求
短语：excess profit — 超额利润；过分利得
短语：excess air coefficient — 过剩空气系数，过量空气系数
短语：excess pore pressure — 超孔隙压力
短语：excess inventory — 过量库存；积压商品
短语：excess cash — [经]超额现金；过剩现金
短语：excess risk — 超额危险度；过分危险
短语：excess voltage — 过压，过电压；超额电压
例句：After you apply the oil, wait 20 minutes before wiping off any excess.
涂上油以后，等20分钟再擦掉多余部分。

excessive
音标：英 /ɪk'sesɪv; ek-/  美 /ɪkˈsɛsɪv/
adj. 过多的，极度的
短语：excessive competition — 过度竞争
短语：excessive drinking — 酗酒；过度饮酒
短语：excessive consumption — 过度消耗；超前消费
短语：excessive pressure — 剩余压力；过度压力
短语：excessive noise — 过度噪音；过分的吵闹声
短语：excessive demand — 过剩需求；过量需求；需求过旺
短语：excessive wear — 过度磨损
短语：excessive speed — 超速
短语：excessive production capacity — 过剩生产能力
例句：his excessive drinking
他的酗酒
例句：$15 for two beers seems a little excessive.
两杯啤酒要15美元，似乎有点过分。

exchange
音标：英 /ɪks'tʃeɪndʒ; eks-/  美 /ɪks'tʃendʒ/
v. 交换；交流
n. 交换
短语：exchange rate — 汇率；兑换率
短语：foreign exchange — 外汇；国际汇兑；外国汇票
短语：stock exchange — 证券交易所
短语：in exchange — 作为交换
短语：exchange for — 交换；兑换
短语：ion exchange — 离子交换
短语：heat exchange — 热传导
短语：in exchange for — 作为…的交换
短语：information exchange — 信息交换；情报交流
短语：cultural exchange — 文化交流
短语：data exchange — 数据交换
短语：exchange with — v. 与…交换
短语：international exchange — 国际汇兑；国际电话局
短语：exchange market — 外汇市场
短语：exchange reserves — 中央银行所持有的自由兑换外汇准备
短语：cation exchange — [化]阳离子交换
短语：ion exchange resin — 离子交换树脂（多孔合成树脂的总称）
短语：foreign exchange market — 外汇市场，外汇交易市场
短语：shanghai stock exchange — 上海证券交易所
短语：exchange system — [计]交换系统；交换制
例句：It’s a place where people can chat and exchange ideas.
在这个地方人们可以聊天和交流想法。

excite
音标：英 /ɪk'saɪt; ek-/  美 /ɪk'saɪt/
v. 使激动；引起
例句：His playing is technically brilliant, but it doesn’t excite me.
他的演奏技巧娴熟，但并不让我激动。

exciting
音标：英 /ɪk'saɪtɪŋ; ek-/  美 /ɪk'saɪtɪŋ/
adj. 令人兴奋的
短语：exciting force — 激发力
短语：exciting experience — 一次刺激的旅行
短语：exciting current — 励磁电流；[电]激磁电流
短语：exciting winding — 励磁绕组；激励线圈
短语：exciting field — 激磁场；励磁场
短语：exciting light — 激发光；激励光；激活光
例句：an exciting discovery
激动人心的发现
例句：‘Julia and Paul are getting married!’ ‘Oh, how exciting!’
“朱莉娅和保罗要结婚了！”“啊，太让人兴奋了！”
例句：I’ve got some very exciting news for you.
我给你带来了一些很激动人心的消息。
例句：Let’s do something exciting.
我们来做些让人振奋的事情吧。
例句：Melanie finds her work exciting and rewarding.
梅拉妮觉得自己的工作既刺激又有意义。

exclaim
音标：英 /ɪk'skleɪm; ek-/  美 /ɪk'sklem/
v. 呼喊；惊叫
例句：‘No!’ she exclaimed in shock.
“不！”她惊呼道。

exclude
音标：英 /ɪk'skluːd; ek-/  美 /ɪk'sklʊd/
v. 把…排除在外
例句：a special diet that excludes dairy products
不包含奶制品的特别食谱
例句：The judges decided to exclude evidence which had been unfairly attained.
法官裁决不接纳以不正当手段获取的证据。

exclusively
音标：英 /ɪk'skluːsɪvlɪ/  美 /ɪk'sklʊsɪvli/
adv. 专门地
例句：These are not involved as exclusively as ministers in "soul-work," but they certainly cultivate the inner life more than the third group.
他们虽不像牧师那样专门做“灵魂方面的工作”，但是肯定比第三群体更注重于建造人类的生命。

excursion
音标：英 /ɪk'skɜːʃ(ə)n; ek-/  美 /ɪk'skɝʒn/
n. 远足；短途旅行
短语：temperature excursion — 温度剧增，超温
例句：a shopping excursion
购物游

excuse
音标：英 /ɪk'skjuːz; ek-/  美 /ɪk'skjʊs/
v. 原谅；免除
n. 借口
短语：excuse oneself — v. 为自己辩解；请求免除；请求准予离开
短语：excuse for — 借口；原谅
短语：make one's excuses — (对不能出席社交聚会等)表示抱歉(或遗憾)
短语：in excuse of — 为……辩解
短语：find an excuse — 借故
短语：without excuse — adj. 无故
短语：reasonable excuse — 合理解释，合理的辩解
短语：excuse myself — 原谅自己；替自己辩解
例句：I’ll excuse you this time, but don’t be late again.
这次我原谅你，但别再迟到了。
例句：Please excuse my bad handwriting.
请原谅，我的字写得不好。

execute
音标：英 /'eksɪkjuːt/  美 /'ɛksɪkjut/
v. 将…处死；实施
短语：execute plan — 执行计划
例句：13 people were summarily executed (= killed without any trial or legal process ) by the guerrillas.
有13人被游击队员就地处决。

executive
音标：英 /ɪg'zekjʊtɪv; eg-/  美 /ɪɡ'zɛkjətɪv/
adj. 执行的
n. 执行者
短语：chief executive — 行政长官；董事长；美国总统；（美国的）州长
短语：executive director — 执行理事；常务董事
短语：executive committee — 执行委员会
短语：executive officer — 主任参谋，执行官
短语：chief executive officer — 首席执行官；总裁
短语：executive search — 猎头（等于headhunting）；搜寻高级管理人员（的做法）
短语：executive power — 行政权；执行权；行政管理权
短语：executive yuan — 行政院
短语：executive vice president — 执行副总裁
短语：executive council — 执行委员会
短语：executive branch — 行政部门
短语：executive board — 执行委员会
短语：senior executive — 高级主管；高级执行官
短语：executive ability — 执行力；行政能力
短语：executive function — 行政上的职能
短语：executive compensation — 管理层薪资水平
短语：executive program — 可执行程序
短语：executive management — 行政管理；高级管理层；主管经理管理层
短语：executive chairman — 执行主席；执行总裁
短语：executive office — 办公室；行政办公室；经理办公室
例句：a commission with executive powers
有执行权的委员会

exercise
音标：英 /'eksəsaɪz/  美 /'ɛksɚsaɪz/
n. 锻炼，训练
v. 练习
短语：take exercise — 做运动；做体操
短语：physical exercise — 体育运动；身体操练
短语：regular exercise — 常规性的锻炼；经常操练，按时训练
短语：aerobic exercise — 有氧运动
短语：do exercise — 锻炼；做运动；做练习
短语：exercise more — 多锻炼，多运动
短语：exercise book — 练习本
短语：military exercise — 军事演习
短语：exercise price — 行使价格；合约价；预购股票价格
短语：morning exercise — 晨练，早操；朝会
短语：exercise prescription — 运动处方
短语：exercise therapy — 运动疗法，运动治疗
短语：strenuous exercise — 剧烈运动
短语：amount of exercise — 运动量
短语：free exercise — 自由体操；[医]主动运动
短语：floor exercise — 自由体操
短语：exercise habit — 运动习惯
短语：breathing exercise — 气功；吐纳功；呼吸操练
短语：exercise physiology — 运动生理学；运动生物学
短语：exercise power — 行使权力；运用权力
例句：Try to fit some regular exercise into your daily routine.
尽量在日常生活中安排一些经常性的锻炼。
例句：Working in an office, I don’t get much exercise.
由于在办公室工作，我很少运动。

exert
音标：英 /ɪg'zɜːt; eg-/  美 /ɪɡ'zɝt/
v. 尽(力)，运用
短语：exert oneself — 努力；尽力
短语：exert an influence on — 对……产生影响
例句：They exerted considerable influence within the school.
他们在校内施加了很大的影响力。
例句：Environmental groups are exerting pressure on the government to tighten pollution laws.
环境保护组织在向政府施加压力，要求从严执行环保法律法规。
